.[$k], .[expr], has($k), in(): bounded re-scan of a captured node; static after inlining is free (about 2-3 days)
patterns bind constant index/key paths; `?//` alternatives need backtracking (about 2 days)
label/break is early exit from a generator (about 1 day on top of limit)
accumulator registers, per design stage 3

guarded region (about 2 days)
keys/type/length/map/select helpers on spans (types and counts)
